name: Acrobatics
summary: You practically fly through the city — leaping, climbing and tumbling.

abilities.name: Climbing
abilities.text: When climbing any surface, leaping over buildings, or moving acrobatically, gain Advantage on your Test.

abilities.name: Acrobatic Jump
abilities.text: Once per Issue, gain an automatic success on an unbelievable feat of jumping or aerial movement.

abilities.name: Free Running
abilities.text: When crossing an area with obstacles (rooftops, walls, gaps), reduce the Tension by 5 to reach your destination quickly.

name: Subterfuge
summary: The art of not being seen and always having an ace up your sleeve.

abilities.name: Slip By
abilities.text: On Agility Tests to sneak around, gain Advantage.

abilities.name: Escapist
abilities.text: Once per Issue, if imprisoned or handcuffed, you may escape automatically.

abilities.name: Unaware Strike
abilities.text: Once per Scene, when damaging a target unaware of you, roll 1 additional Tier Damage Die.

name: Tech
summary: Expert in electronics, programming and advanced devices.

abilities.name: Hacker
abilities.text: With the right tools, break into sophisticated systems: Advantage on hacking and code-breaking Tests.

abilities.name: Tech Rat
abilities.text: Spend a Scene studying a technological item to completely understand how it works.

abilities.name: Technological Gadget
abilities.text: At the start of the Issue, choose one Gear item to receive; use it by the end of the Issue.

name: Strategy
summary: A master of tactics and planning who foresees movements and elaborate maneuvers.

abilities.name: Plan B
abilities.text: Once per Issue, when you fail a Test, describe your backup plan and reroll, keeping the second result.

abilities.name: Maneuver Number 7!
abilities.text: At the start of a Scene, choose one Attribute on a target character; they gain a bonus equal to your Tier on their next roll with it.

abilities.name: Tactical Analysis
abilities.text: Once per Issue, quickly analyze a target to discover one of: a Weakness, their Resolve, one Attribute, or the first action they'll take.
